items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: I worked in intermission. I was playing intermission for him at Gaspar's on Bourbon Street.

ctx.x: He died when he was quite young. Yeah.

I worked in intermission. I was playing intermission for him at Gaspar's on Bourbon Street. And they had an opera at one of the places in New Orleans. And the conductor came after. And Gaspar knew Bourbon, the man who owned the place was Gaspar. He knew Bourbon could play. And he came up and told Bourbon, he said, here's a long-haired guy. And he said, I want you to play something for him. And Bourbon played a classic that the man jumped up and said it can't be done. Honest. He said it just can't be done. A man…
That's how great he was. That's right.
